meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后它会读取本地 screenpipe 记录的屏幕活动,按你给的时间窗口找出重复的工作流,与仓库里已有的技能比对,产出可审核的技能草稿或组合配方。
howto.when: 当你明确要求分析近期工作并据此提出技能时触发;需要本地 3030 端口的 screenpipe 在运行,连不上会直接拒绝,非用户主动要求不运行。

say.text: 用 dry-run 分析我昨天的工作,先给我看时间线
分析我这周的重复工作流,起草新的技能
把这个提案提升为正式技能,名字叫 zotero-pubmed-helper
say.note: 移入 skills/,已存在则拒绝

howto.what_en: Once installed, it reads your local screenpipe screen history, finds repeated workflows in a time window you give, compares them with existing repo skills, and drafts reviewable skills or composition recipes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask it to analyze your recent work and propose skills; requires a screenpipe daemon on local port 3030 and refuses to run if unreachable.

say_en.text: Analyze my work yesterday with a dry-run and show me the timeline first
Analyze my repeated workflows this week and draft new skills
Promote this proposal into a real skill named zotero-pubmed-helper
say_en.note: Moves it into skills/, refuses overwrite
